authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant physical implausibility artifacts. Six adult zebras standing on a single motorcycle would cause immediate structural collapse; the motorcycle shows no deformation, bending, or suspension compression despite bearing ~2000kg of load. The rear zebras appear to float or merge with the truck's roof rack without clear grounding. Zebra hooves lack realistic contact shadows or pressure deformation on the motorcycle seat. While texture quality is high and lighting is consistent, the fundamental physics violation and spatial ambiguity of the rear zebras reduce authenticity. The animal pose auditor's HIGH risk rating (42% low-confidence keypoints) corroborates widespread anatomical/structural uncertainty in the zebra limbs.
key_defects: Spatial inversion: Motorcycle is in front of truck, not behind as prompted
Physics violation: Motorcycle bears impossible weight of six zebras without deformation
Ambiguous grounding: Rear zebras appear to stand on truck roof rack, not motorcycle
Taxonomy mismatch: Motorcycle is a standard street bike, not a motor scooter as defined in diagnostics
Structural artifact: High pose uncertainty in zebra limbs suggests anatomical inconsistencies
